name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible ClipFlow problem

---

## What happened

Describe the behavior and what you expected.

## Steps to reproduce

Use a generated clip and fictional account information where possible.

## Environment

- ClipFlow version or commit
- OS and Node.js version
- Browser and FFmpeg version if relevant

## Diagnostics

Share only redacted logs or sanitized screenshots. Keep credentials, local files, account identifiers, and private data out of the issue. Use [private reporting](https://github.com/Sarif-02/ClipFlow/security/advisories/new) for vulnerabilities.
